title: Claude Code --max-turns: Stop Agents Looping Forever
description:
Is your AI agent stuck in an endless loop? 🔁

✅ Cap agent turns with the --max-turns flag
✅ Add a spend limit with --max-budget-usd
✅ Read why it stopped with jq -r .subtype

comment: Turns or dollars: which cap would you set first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: --max-turns only works in print mode (claude -p), so use it in scripts and CI runs.
